newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Five killed in Namibia plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Namibia plane crash.

text.p: Namibian search teams located a missing Cessna aircraft and pulled the bodies of all five victims from the burnt-out wreck on Monday, a rescue official said on Tuesday.
"You couldn't even recognise the wreck from the air. Five bodies were retrieved by helicopter," Joggie Sell of the Search and Rescue Centre of the civil aviation directorate told Reuters.
Sell said the plane was found in a deep valley in the Namib-Naukluft Park, in southwestern Namibia, after a five-day search.
"Inspectors from the Department of Civil Aviation will go out and spend a whole day there to start the investigation on the spot," Sell said.
The charter plane, with a pilot and four passengers, went missing last week while on a sightseeing flight to the popular tourist destinations of Sesriem and Sossusvlei.
